PEEFACE. 

Vert  few  persons,  except  those  who  have  studied  the  Biblical  Illustrator  to  any 
extent,  can  be  at  all  aware  of  the  immense  amount  of  material  stored  up  within  the 
volumes  of  the  New  Testament  portion.  The  preparation  of  this  Index  was  there- 
fore rendered  an  absolute  necessity  if  this  veritable  treasury  of  information  was  to 
be  in  any  sense  made  available  to  those  for  whose  use  it  had  been  gathered 
together. 

Some  idea  of  the  extent  of  this  work  may,  however,  be  obtained  when  it  is  con- 
sidered that  there  are  in  this  Index  close  on  70,000  entries,  and  the  duplicates, 
which  in  some  instances  are  very  numerous,  count  for  at  least  another  7000.  Of 
this  large  total  those  embraced  under  the  letter  C  alone  amount  to  9510,  of  which 
some  2400  will  be  found  under  the  name  Christ. 

With  regard  to  the  order  of  the  grouping  of  the  words,  it  may  be  said  that  the 
usual  arrangement  of  Indices  has  been  carried  out — the  singular  and  its  possessive 
are  invariably  followed  by  the  plural  and  its  possessive — even  where  the  word  tnds 
in  y,  as  being  easier  to  find.  The  only  noteworthy  exceptions  are  in  the  cases  of 
man  and  men,  and  a  few  others  where  the  vowel  is  changed. 

All  the  nouns,  the  important  adjectives,  and  the  more  prominent  verbs  will  be 
found  included  in  this  Index,  and  in  a  few  instances  a  well-known  adverb  is  given. 

To  save  space  the  particles  a  and  the  will  generally  be  found  to  be  omitted 
throughout  ;  the  rare  cases  in  which  they  appear  being  those  in  which  they  are 
necessary  to  make  the  subject-heading  clear. 

The  capital  letters,  S.,  I.,  and  A.,  are,  as  indicated  on  page  1,  designed  to  show 
whether  the  heading  indicates  a  Sermon  outline,  Illustration,  or  Anecdote.  The 
small  numerals  indicate  the  volume  in  which  these  may  be  Ibund  where  more  than 
one  volume  has  been  issued  on  the  Scripture  Hook. 

Full  advantage  has  been  taken  of  cross  relerences,  in  order  that  all  the  terms 
used  for  the  same  item  searched  for  can  be  made  of  use. 

An  attempt  was  made  to  compile  lists  of  addresses  suitable  for  the  special 
seasons  and  occasions  of  the  Christian  Church's  life  and  work  ;  but  it  was  found 
that  to  do  this  in  anything  like  a  worthj'  manner  would  take  at  least  50  additional 
pages  of  the  Index,  whereas  abundant  material  bearing  upon  nearly  every  conceiv- 
able subject  and  event  will  be  found  grouped  under  the  required  special  topic-word. 
The  attempt  was  accordingly  abandoned. 

The  time  and  labour  spent  upon  the  compilation  of  this  Index  Volume  can  only 
be  roughly  estimated  :  the  alphabetical  arrangement  alone  filled  up  all  spare  time 
for  over  nine  months,  with  several  whole  days  thrown  in. 

With  such  a  mass  of  figures  it  is  too  much  to  expect  that  all  mistakes  have  been 
avoided  ;  but  the  compiler  trusts  that  the  Index  will  be  found  as'free  from  errors  as 
a  double  checking  on  his  part  and  praiseworthy  care  on  the  part  of  the  printers  can 
have  ensured. 

All  the  Biblical  Illustrator  volumes  of  the  New  Testament  series  are  in  print, 
and  can  be  obtained  from  the  Publisher.
